surface_mechanism_description: The surface reactions involve the decomposition of (MeCp)Ir(CHD) precursor and the interaction with molecular oxygen. The process includes the formation of IrO2 and the regeneration of surface hydroxyl groups through water pulses. The mechanism is similar to other ALD Ir processes, where the precursor decomposes and reacts with oxygen to form the desired film.
evidence: The text discusses the ALD process using (MeCp)Ir(CHD) and molecular oxygen, mentioning the formation of IrO2 and the role of surface hydroxyl groups. It also notes that the partial decomposition of the precursor can lead to defects on the film surface, indicating the involvement of intermediate species during the reaction.
